item.title: Refactor orders: order status String to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit your work.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization are done. The structural goal: replace `Order::status: String` in the `orders` crate with an `OrderStatus` enum (new `src/status.rs`, `FromStr` with `ParseStatusError`, `as_str`/`Display`, `can_transition_to`, root re-exports). All status literals should end up only in `src/status.rs`. Observable behaviour must not change.

Commits (branch archon/k5q0z37k-refactor-orders-order-status-string-to-o, not pushed, worktree clean):
- Original baseline: eb4f904cdf1c08bd05e981548d1d139ecef6ecd8 (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf)
- Characterization: 1da5ed6 "test: characterize order lifecycle, status reports and CSV parsing" (tree f7c428c23628f71c4ce734180f5e1526c785d35a). It adds only tests/characterization.rs and changes no production code or existing tests. I used the repo's git identity (mengsig) and no attribution lines, following the CLAUDE.md rule.

Checks (cargo from ~/.cargo/bin, CARGO_TARGET_DIR set to the item cache):
- Before tests: `cargo test --locked` → exit 0, 3 passed (unit 0, tests/orders.rs 3, doc 0).
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` → exit 0 (after rustup added the clippy component).
- `cargo fmt --check` → exit 1, pre-existing. billing.rs:2, order.rs:23, report.rs:15,23, shipping.rs:2 and tests/orders.rs:40 are not rustfmt-clean at eb4f904. I did not reformat them, to avoid noise in the lines the refactor touches. The new file passes `rustfmt --check`.
- After tests: `cargo test --locked` → exit 0, 20 characterization tests plus 3 existing, all passing against unchanged production code. Clippy still exit 0.
- Rustup components rustfmt and clippy were installed into the toolchain. This is an environment change, not a repo change.

Public surface to preserve (the allowed contract change is only `Order::status` becoming `OrderStatus`):
- `Order { pub id: u32, pub customer: String, pub total_cents: u64, pub status }`; `Order::new(u32,&str,u64)` starts pending; `is_open()`; `cancel() -> Result<(),String>`. Re-exported from the crate root.
- `billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(),String>`; `billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64` (pending only).
- `shipping::ship(&mut Order) -> Result<(),String>`; `shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>` (input order, paid only).
- `report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String,usize)>`. Output is sorted by name: cancelled, paid, pending, shipped. Trap: a derived `Ord` on the enum sorts by declaration order, so names must be kept.
- `report::to_line` gives `id,customer,total_cents,status`. `report::from_line` trims the whole line and returns `Result<Order,String>`.
- Exact error strings: "order N cannot be paid|shipped|cancelled: it is <status>", "expected 4 fields, got N", "bad id \"x\": <parse error>", "bad total \"x\": <parse error>", "unknown status \"<raw>\"". Status matching is case-sensitive and not trimmed per field.
- The `status_counts` return type `String` → `OrderStatus` is a public signature change the brief does not explicitly allow. The tests use `.to_string()`, so they compile either way. The refactorer should decide and flag this.

Coverage: the new file pins all four statuses' CSV names and round trips, the refusal messages for every illegal pay/ship/cancel path, cancel from pending and paid, is_open per status, name-sorted counts with all four statuses, outstanding and ready-to-ship ordering, and every `from_line` error message plus the whitespace and case rules. Known gaps: no CLI or wire format exists here. Reference tests are `tests/orders.rs` (existing) and `tests/characterization.rs` (new).

Feedback: none on this first attempt. Nothing is running, so no services need stopping.

pr.body:
Approach: new src/status.rs holds OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled), as_str/Display, FromStr with ParseStatusError (Display: unknown status "<input>"), and can_transition_to encoding pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Root re-exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError; the module itself is private.

Key files: src/status.rs (new), src/order.rs (field type; cancel guarded by can_transition_to), src/billing.rs (pay guarded by can_transition_to), src/shipping.rs (ship guarded by can_transition_to), src/report.rs (from_line uses FromStr; status_counts keyed by as_str so output stays sorted by name, not by enum declaration order), src/lib.rs.

Public contract: Order::status changes from String to OrderStatus (the only allowed change). status_counts still returns Vec<(String, usize)>. Error strings, CSV format, parse order and report order are unchanged; the characterization tests in tests/characterization.rs pass unmodified and no pre-existing test was edited.

Checks: cargo test --locked and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings both exit 0. Not clean: cargo fmt --check still reports tests/orders.rs:40 (pre-existing, left alone).

Left open: no CLI or wire format in this crate, so those callers are not checked here.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now: OrderStatus with as_str/Display/FromStr and can_transition_to; literals only in status.rs. before: String status compared against literals in 4 files; now: enum everywhere, same messages, same CSV format, same report output.
pr.title: refactor: store order status as OrderStatus instead of String

risk.why: Public field type change on Order::status (brief-authorized) breaks downstream code that reads it as a String. Behaviour is pinned by 20 characterization tests and 3 existing tests, all passing unchanged. Touches only the orders crate; no persistence, auth or concurrency code.

stages.summary:
Verification of the OrderStatus refactor (commit c03f7ab) passes. Behaviour is preserved, and the only public change is the one the brief allows.

Checks, all run in the clean worktree:
- `cargo test --locked`: exit 0. Unit 3 (new, in status.rs), characterization 20 passed, tests/orders.rs 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: exit 0.
- `cargo build --locked`: exit 0.
- `cargo fmt --check`: exit 1 with one diff, tests/orders.rs:40. The baseline has the same diff, and the refactor cleared the four src files that were unformatted at baseline. The repo declares no fmt gate, so I treat this as a pre-existing note, not a failure.

Test modifications: none. tests/orders.rs and tests/characterization.rs are byte-identical to eb4f904 and 1da5ed6, so the characterization expectations were not changed and ran unchanged.

Behaviour probe: a 46-line matrix covering every pay/ship/cancel from every status, outstanding_cents, ready_to_ship, status_counts, to_line, and from_line on 27 valid and malformed inputs. Baseline and head outputs are byte-identical; each side was built in its own target dir after a shared-target artifact issue was caught and corrected.

Public surface: the only change is Order::status String -> OrderStatus, plus the new re-exports. status_counts keeps Vec<(String, usize)>. One non-allowed-looking difference is noted: derived Debug of Order prints `status: Pending` instead of `status: "pending"`. It follows from the authorised type change and is not part of the contract, so it is non-blocking.

Status literals appear only in src/status.rs. Nothing was pushed, and no services were started. The worktree is clean. Evidence (logs, probe source and outputs) is at .archon/data/cache/refactor-order-status/items/qi_01M7W8R8V3WEV0F9Y2K5Q0Z37K/evidence. Publishing was refused because that path is outside the workspace.

VERDICT: PASS
